---
title: "Northern Territory"
subtitle: "General Government Sector fiscal positions"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

JURIS <- "NT"

facts <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_latest) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)

per_capita <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_per_capita) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)

per_gsp <- tryCatch(
  tar_read(facts_per_gsp) |> filter(jurisdiction == JURIS),
  error = function(e) tibble::tibble()
)
```

## Headline variables

::: {.callout-note}
Data currently shown is from PLACEHOLDER CSVs under
`data/extracted/nt/`. Replace those values with extracted figures
from the source Budget Papers; everything downstream (per-capita
normalisation against ABS ERP, revisions panel, aggregates) flows
through automatically.
:::

```{r controls}
#| label: linked-chart

if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No facts in the warehouse yet for NT.")
} else {
  ## Long panel covering absolute / per-capita / per-GSP views in
  ## one table so a single SharedData backs all three.
  long <- facts |>
    transmute(variable_id, canonical_label, fiscal_year,
              is_forward_estimate, value = value_aud_mil,
              view = "absolute_aud_mil") |>
    bind_rows(
      per_capita |> transmute(variable_id, canonical_label, fiscal_year,
                              is_forward_estimate,
                              value = value_per_capita_aud,
                              view = "per_capita_aud")
    ) |>
    bind_rows(
      per_gsp |> transmute(variable_id, canonical_label, fiscal_year,
                           is_forward_estimate,
                           value = value_share_gsp * 100,
                           view = "share_gsp_pct")
    )

  shared <- SharedData$new(long)

  bscols(
    widths = c(3, 9),
    list(
      filter_select("var",  "Variable",       shared, ~canonical_label),
      filter_select("view", "Normalisation",  shared, ~view, multiple = FALSE),
      filter_slider("fy",   "Fiscal year",    shared, ~fiscal_year,
                    step = 1, sep = "")
    ),
    plot_ly(shared,
            x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value,
            color = ~is_forward_estimate,
            colors = c(`FALSE` = "#1f3a93", `TRUE` = "#5a6c7d"),
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            line = list(width = 2.5),
            hovertemplate = paste(
              "<b>%{x}</b><br>",
              "Value: %{y:,.2f}<extra></extra>"
            )) |>
      sbm_theme_fiscal(
        title       = paste(JURIS, "--- selected variable"),
        yaxis_title = "value"
      )
  )
}
```

## Fact table

```{r fact-table}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No facts in the warehouse yet for NT.")
} else {
  facts |>
    select(variable_id, canonical_label, category, fiscal_year, value_aud_mil,
           is_forward_estimate, estimate_type, document_id, release_date) |>
    arrange(category, variable_id, fiscal_year) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE,
      defaultColDef   = colDef(minWidth = 90)
    )
}
```
